title: Size, Catholic military school and school grades
summary: At 6'4" he was embarrassed by his height; military school fixed his posture. He excelled in subjects he liked and failed gym until he joined football.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: You mentioned, and just for the record, when you went to kindergarten you were too big. And just as a matter of record, you must have always been big. How tall are you now?

Well, I'm 6'4" now. In the 8th grade I was 6' and my feet were size 12. It was very embarrassing. I felt awkward. But I went to a Catholic military school in the 9th grade and they made me stand up straight and march and everything. So I didn't get a stoop or anything.
So how long did you stay in California? What was your school life and all like?

Well, I did very well in school if I liked the subject. If I didn't like it I practically failed it. I think if my grandmother had not been a teacher I wouldn't have gotten through. They did it out of consideration for her. I would get A-- in high school, I would get A's in chemistry, biology, art and music. I would fail in things like English or history or political science. But I didn't know -- nobody'd ever told me that you're supposed to take the book home and study it. I just thought if you didn't learn it when they told it to you, that's too bad. So I could remember anything on a subject I liked.

My children saw my report cards when they were in high school and they were looking at me in amazement saying, 'How do you get an F in gym?' It was simple, I refused to go out for football the first year and they flunked me. So the next year I went out for football.
